fees.notes: Official UniMAP international tuition fee schedule (TUITION_FEE_SCHEDULE_FOR_INTERNATIONAL_STUDENTS.pdf, published 09 Aug 2023, still linked from unimap.edu.my): Faculty of Business & Communication bachelor programmes are RM3,520/year recurring tuition over 3 years (RM10,560 total); Year 1 also carries a one-off RM5,380 registration & personal bond fee (Year 1 total RM8,900). fees.total = recurring tuition only; fees.per_year = official annual recurring tuition. The per-programme provisional international fee figure shown on admission.unimap.edu.my is the site's own placeholder, not the official schedule. Source: https://www.unimap.edu.my/images/admission/TUITION_FEE_SCHEDULE_FOR_INTERNATIONAL_STUDENTS.pdf (accessed 2026-09-18).
